stories.h: Neighbors may be a bad fit in Ohio State's offense
stories.d: [[p:557719074|T.Neighbors]] is a 91-overall receiver on a team ranked 125th of 138 in receptions. After the Nebraska loss, a source says other programs are already sniffing around.

quote.text: He's a playmaker who isn't getting the ball. Guys like that start listening.
quote.by: a source close to the player

stories.h: Lyle could hit the portal if Ohio State's passing game stays stuck
stories.d: [[p:557713038|B.Lyle]], a 90-overall pocket passer, plays for an [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] offense ranked 130th of 138 in passing yards per game. The loss to Nebraska only fueled the chatter about his future.

quote.text: He wants to throw the ball. Right now that's not the offense.
quote.by: a person close to the QB room

stories.h: Blunt's future at Ohio State is murky as the run game sputters
stories.d: [[p:557717760|S.Blunt]], an 88-overall back, plays for an [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] team ranked 127th of 138 in rushing yards per game. A back who seeks contact wants carries, and the scheme isn't giving him many.

quote.text: He's built to run downhill. The offense isn't set up for it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Boger is underpaid, and Wake Forest may have to pay up
stories.d: [[p:557718710|D.Boger]] is an 84-overall quarterback making 65K, while players at his position and rating command around 160K. That gap tends to close in the portal. [[t:832438407|Wake Forest]] needs to decide how much he's worth.

quote.text: Somebody's going to pay him. It's just a matter of who calls first.
quote.by: a rival collective source

stories.h: Harrell Leaves East Carolina for Stanford and a Defense Full of Questions
stories.d: [[c:H0ldStillPlease|Coach Harrell]] is leaving [[t:832438301|East Carolina]] after going 19-19 to take over a [[t:832438379|Stanford]] program that is 0-1. The Cardinal job comes with a bigger name and a much bigger rebuild, starting with the secondary.

quote.text: He wanted a bigger stage, and he knows what he's walking into on defense. Nobody there is under any illusions.
quote.by: a source close to the Stanford program

stories.h: Rashed Is an 88-Overall Safety on a Bargain Deal. [[t:832438288|BYU]] Could Pounce.
stories.d: [[p:557718419|I.Rashed]] makes 65K while safeties of his caliber get around 140K. Rival collectives have noticed, and [[t:832438288|BYU]] is the name being floated as a team willing to close that gap.

quote.text: You don't leave an 88 at that number for long. Somebody's going to make a call, and the player knows it.
quote.by: a rival staffer

stories.h: Ole Miss holds the lead for Wilds, but Texas won't back off
stories.d: [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] has the edge for five-star corner [[r:561119626|W. Wilds]], with [[t:832438384|Texas]] right behind and Oklahoma still in the mix. Wilds wants a title contender, and sources say he is weighing who is likeliest to win one.

quote.text: He keeps asking one question: who's actually winning it all?
quote.by: a source close to the recruiting process

stories.h: Missouri clings to a slim lead over Indiana for Favre
stories.d: [[t:832438344|Missouri]] is ahead for [[r:561121675|I. Favre]], but Indiana has closed hard and Michigan is lurking. Conference prestige is his dealbreaker, and Missouri's staff has reportedly been working to make that case.

quote.text: Indiana has changed the way his family talks about this. It's a real race now.
quote.by: a person familiar with Favre's thinking

stories.h: Clemson leads for Coburn, but home-state pull could swing it to Alabama
stories.d: [[t:832438293|Clemson]] has the advantage for five-star [[r:561125724|P. Coburn]], but proximity to home is his dealbreaker and [[t:832438274|Alabama]] is a short drive from Coral Springs. Ole Miss is also lurking.

quote.text: His mom keeps saying she wants to see him play on Saturdays. That matters.
quote.by: a source close to the family

stories.h: Georgia leads Miami for Yeast, but playing time is the wild card
stories.d: [[t:832438312|Georgia]] holds the edge for five-star receiver [[r:561121494|W. Yeast]]. [[t:832438337|Miami]] has been selling an immediate role and has not backed down, and Florida State is lurking. Georgia's staff is reportedly feeling it.

quote.text: He doesn't want to wait his turn. Whoever shows him the field wins.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Texas Tech edges Texas for Wolf in a tight playing-time fight
stories.d: [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] has a slim lead for five-star corner [[r:561121140|E. Wolf]] over [[t:832438384|Texas]], with Ole Miss lurking. Wolf cares about early snaps, and both staffs have pitched him a quick path to the field.

quote.text: He keeps coming back to who lets him start as a freshman.
quote.by: a Wolf family associate

stories.h: Notre Dame's national spotlight is working on Longo
stories.d: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] leads for five-star receiver [[r:561120536|C. Longo]], with [[t:832438344|Missouri]] and Oklahoma close behind. Longo wants national exposure, and Notre Dame offers plenty of it. Official visits could decide this one.

quote.text: He loves the idea of playing on that stage every Saturday.
quote.by: a source close to Longo

stories.h: Stanford Lands Durante, a California Safety Who Wanted to Start
stories.d: Stanford sold the three-star strong safety on a chance to compete right away. For a pass defense that has been a problem, that pitch carries weight. Durante is staying close to home, and his family played a role.

quote.text: I believe I can come in and start right away. That's what I wanted.
quote.by: M. Durante

stories.h: Texas Holds Edge for Simonson, but Tennessee and USC Aren't Going Away
stories.d: [[r:561121938|K. Simonson]] has Texas in front, Tennessee close behind and USC still in the picture. Conference prestige is his dealbreaker, and the Longhorns are benefiting from it. One more big week could settle it.

quote.text: He keeps coming back to the league he'll be playing in. That's the first thing he brings up every time we talk.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

stories.h: Texas Receiver T.Bada Is Producing Like a Star and Earning Nothing
stories.d: [[p:557719687|T.Bada]] is an 87-overall receiver with no NIL deal, while comparable receivers get around 90K. [[t:832438384|Texas]] has one of the deepest collectives in the country, but rivals are already calling.

quote.text: Everyone knows what he's worth. The only question is whether Texas fixes it before somebody else does.
quote.by: a rival collective staffer

stories.h: E.Udoh Is Playing Like a Star and Getting Paid Like a Backup
stories.d: [[p:557727130|E.Udoh]] is an 88-overall receiver with no NIL money, while receivers at his level get around 105K. Collectives know the gap well, and one source says he has already heard from several of them.

quote.text: He's not complaining, but he knows the market. His phone isn't quiet.
quote.by: a person familiar with his situation

stories.h: B.Bouye Is an 87-Overall Back With No NIL Deal. Is SMU the Answer?
stories.d: [[p:557714489|B.Bouye]] has no NIL money, while running backs at his level get around 85K. Collectives are lining up, and [[t:832438375|SMU]] is a name coming up in the chatter. Running backs with this production don't stay unpaid for long once the portal opens.

quote.text: A back like that doesn't sit on the market. The first serious offer is probably the one he takes.
quote.by: a portal-focused agent

stories.h: No. 1 Ohio State falls to Nebraska and the bracket takes a hit
stories.d: The top-ranked team in the country lost to Nebraska despite moving the ball. Tuddy_roosevelt's team had the yards and still left with a loss. Per a source close to the program, the mood in the building afterward was ugly.

quote.text: We did everything but finish. That's what's eating guys up.
quote.by: a source close to the Ohio State program

stories.h: Harrell leaves East Carolina for Stanford and a No. 25 ranking
stories.d: [[c:H0ldStillPlease|Coach Harrell]] goes from a 19-19 run at [[t:832438301|East Carolina]] to a Stanford program that starts the year ranked No. 25. Players on both rosters are already deciding whether to stay.

quote.text: He sold the Stanford staff on a clean slate. Whether the roster buys it is another question.
quote.by: a source close to the Stanford program

stories.h: Nebraska's fourth-down aggression broke Ohio State in a 28-25 win
stories.d: [[t:832438348|Nebraska]] converted 3 of 4 fourth-down tries, and each one seemed to drain a little more out of the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] defense. A Buckeyes staffer admitted the sideline went quiet after the second conversion.

quote.text: Every time they stayed out there, you could feel our guys deflate.
quote.by: an Ohio State defensive staffer

stories.h: Texas holds the edge for five-star corner Wilds, but TCU is pushing
stories.d: [[t:832438384|Texas]] has the slight lead for [[r:561119626|W. Wilds]], who says he wants a championship contender. [[t:832438381|TCU]] is pitching hard that it is one, and Ole Miss is hanging around. Someone's heart gets broken on signing day.

quote.text: He keeps asking one question: who's actually going to win it all? That's the whole recruitment.
quote.by: a person close to Wilds

stories.h: Missouri barely ahead of Tennessee for Favre, and TCU hasn't gone away
stories.d: [[r:561121675|I. Favre]] cares about conference prestige, and that has kept [[t:832438344|Missouri]] and [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] in a tight race. [[t:832438381|TCU]] is lurking. Both leaders are expected to empty the playbook this week.

quote.text: He wants to play on Saturdays that matter. The league has to sell itself.
quote.by: Favre's high school coach

stories.h: Georgia leads for five-star Coburn, but Florida State has the home-field card
stories.d: [[t:832438312|Georgia]] has the lead for [[r:561125724|P. Coburn]], but proximity to home is his dealbreaker. That is where [[t:832438310|Florida State]] could swing it. Miami is lurking and Georgia's staff is nervous.

quote.text: His family wants to see him play down the road. That matters more than people think.
quote.by: a source close to the recruitment

stories.h: Tennessee leads Clemson for Yeast, but Alabama is crashing the party
stories.d: [[r:561121494|W. Yeast]] wants a clear path to playing time. [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] has the edge on that front, [[t:832438293|Clemson]] isn't backing off, and Alabama is still lurking.

quote.text: Show him the depth chart, show him the snaps. That's what he's asking every staff.
quote.by: a person close to Yeast

stories.h: Tennessee's national brand could be the tiebreaker for five-star Longo
stories.d: [[r:561120536|C. Longo]] wants the biggest stage. [[t:832438344|Missouri]] and [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] are even, but Tennessee's brand exposure grades out as elite. Texas is lurking, and official visits could settle it.

quote.text: He keeps coming back to the national spotlight. Tennessee checks that box better than anyone.
quote.by: a source close to the recruitment

stories.h: Texas pulls ahead of USC for Simonson, with Tennessee still watching
stories.d: [[t:832438384|Texas]] has built a lead for [[r:561121938|K. Simonson]], whose dealbreaker is conference prestige. [[t:832438375|SMU]] is not in this one, but USC and Tennessee are lurking. One more strong week could end it.

quote.text: The conference name carries weight with him. Texas has had the best week.
quote.by: a rival staffer

stories.h: Sophomore Naanee's breakout leaves East Carolina with a pricey problem
stories.d: [[p:557717923|L.Naanee]] is up 13 points to 78 overall and earning nothing in NIL. With a coaching change at [[t:832438301|East Carolina]], rival collectives are already taking notice.

quote.text: A new staff, a big jump, and no money. Calls are going to start coming.
quote.by: a rival collective source

stories.h: Ball State freshman Gastineau is a bigger name than anyone budgeted for
stories.d: [[p:557711974|J.Gastineau]], a freshman corner, jumped 13 points to 76 overall and earns nothing in NIL. [[t:832438282|Ball State]] ranks 96th in NIL spending, so a bidding war is a losing proposition.

quote.text: Bigger programs have noticed him. Ball State can't match that kind of money.
quote.by: a portal-watching source

stories.h: Baylor receiver Fuller is getting paid like a role player and playing like a star
stories.d: [[p:557714494|M.Fuller]] is up 12 points to 82 overall and earning nothing in NIL. Expect collectives to circle the sophomore, and [[t:832438283|Baylor]] has little time to fix it.

quote.text: He's earning nothing, and everyone knows it. That changes fast.
quote.by: a source familiar with Baylor's roster

stories.h: Kennesaw State freshman Levine is a star on a small-budget team
stories.d: [[p:557720960|P.Levine]] is up 12 points to 82 overall, and his NIL number is still zero. [[t:832438326|Kennesaw State]] ranks 113th in NIL spending, so keeping him will be hard.

quote.text: Players like that don't stay on small-school money for long.
quote.by: a rival recruiting coordinator

stories.h: Florida State's Shor is up 11 points, and he knows his worth
stories.d: [[p:557724098|J.Shor]], a freshman receiver, jumped 11 points to 80 overall and earns nothing in NIL. Keeping him will cost [[t:832438310|Florida State]], which has plenty of other holes.

quote.text: He's not going to ask. Other schools will do it for him.
quote.by: a person close to the program

stories.h: Trueblood is a bargain at Tennessee, but rival collectives are circling
stories.d: [[p:557719266|L.Trueblood]] is an 89-overall guard making nothing in NIL, while players at his position and rating command around 190K. [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] has the fourth-deepest NIL pockets nationally, but rival collectives have noticed.

quote.text: A guard that good at that price won't stay quiet for long.
quote.by: a rival collective source

stories.h: Carraway may not want to stay in a Stanford pass defense that struggles
stories.d: [[p:557712567|D.Carraway]] is an 84-overall hybrid safety on a [[t:832438379|Stanford]] defense ranked 135th of 138 against the pass. New coach Harrell has a talent to keep on his hands.

quote.text: He's a good player stuck in a bad system. That's a recipe for the portal.
quote.by: a source close to the Stanford program

stories.h: Penn State's Stockton is a running back to watch if the ground game doesn't improve
stories.d: [[p:557716795|I.Stockton]] is an 81-overall contact seeker in a Penn State system that ranks 122nd of 138 in rushing. agerm40 needs to fix the run game or risk losing him.

quote.text: He wants a system that actually runs the ball. Right now it's not that.
quote.by: a source close to the Penn State program

stories.h: Rival collectives are circling SMU running back Bouye
stories.d: [[p:557714489|B.Bouye]] is an 87-overall back earning nothing while players like him command around 85K. [[t:832438375|SMU]] has a gap to close, and rivals are watching.

quote.text: He's about to get offers. Everyone is talking about it.
quote.by: a rival collective source

stories.h: Florida State's pass defense could push top safety Page out the door
stories.d: [[p:557726531|T.Page]] is an 88-overall coverage safety on a [[t:832438310|Florida State]] defense ranked 136th of 138 against the pass. Good players don't stay in bad systems.

quote.text: He knows he's too good for this. The question is who calls first.
quote.by: a source close to the Florida State program

stories.h: Melvin is playing like a star at tackle and getting paid like a backup
stories.d: [[p:557719942|J.Melvin]] is an 84-overall tackle making 30K, while players at his position and rating command around 85K. That gap tends to close in the portal.

quote.text: Linemen like that don't stay underpaid. Someone will fix it.
quote.by: a rival staffer

stories.h: Georgia could be the school to cash in on cornerback Maddox
stories.d: [[p:557712320|K.Maddox]] is an 84-overall corner making nothing in NIL, while players like him command around 50K. [[t:832438312|Georgia]]'s deep pockets make it a natural suitor, but it won't be alone.

quote.text: Georgia has the money and the need. He's on their board.
quote.by: a source familiar with the process

stories.h: Payday: who cashed in this offseason
stories.d: $2.84 million in new money across the top 10, and nine of them changed schools to get it. Nobody got a bigger bump than [[p:557718485|Q.Cookus]]: 0K to 450K.

stories.h: Next up: the breakout candidates for the new season
stories.d: Rating jumps from offseason training, new starting jobs, scheme fits and what they did with limited snaps last year. These are the names to know before kickoff.
